sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Electrophysiological recordings and imaging performed on neurons expressing HA-NLGN4X; WT construct used as functional control alongside ASD-associated mutants, indicating the tag does not prevent surface trafficking or synaptic function.
sites.rationale: NLGN4X is a single-pass type-I transmembrane protein with a single large extracellular domain (residues 42–676) and an intracellular C-terminal tail (698–816); the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus. The 'HA-NLGN4X' prefix notation in both L3 and L1 unambiguously places the HA tag at the N-terminus of the mature protein. The signal peptide spans residues 1–41 (computed), so the tag must be inserted after residue 41 (last SP residue S) and before residue 42 (mature N-terminus Q) to avoid co-translational cleavage. Python verification confirms aa(41)=S and aa(42)=Q. The tag is 635 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of any constraint. pCAG-HA-NLGN4X (WT, S712A, S712D, R704C) full-length membrane-anchored constructs expressed in neurons for biochemical, electrophysiological, and imaging experiments (PMC11913403); independently corroborated by HA-NLGN4X expressed in developing mouse cortical neurons (PMC8895740, L1).

sources.claim: Human pCAG-HA-NLGN4X (WT, S712A, S712D, or R704C)-IRES-mCherry and pCAG-NLmiRs-GFP plasmids were used for biochemical, electrophysiological, and imaging experiments. pGEX-GST-NLGN ICD constructs were made as previously described ( Bemben et al., 2014 ).

literature_notes: Three ledger lines were evaluated. L1 (PMC8895740) and L3 (PMC11913403) both report 'HA-NLGN4X' prefix-notation constructs, converging on the same N-terminal extracellular junction (after SP cleavage at residue 41). L3 was chosen as the primary supporting clip because it names the construct explicitly (pCAG-HA-NLGN4X) and reports electrophysiological and imaging assays, yielding a surface_and_function validation level; L1 is a corroborating independent study. L2 (PMC6706319) reports 'NLGN4-HA' (suffix notation = C-terminal tag), which is intracellular and therefore recorded in other_positions only. No ledger line names a specific residue for the tag junction; the position is topology-derived from the single extracellular terminus. No internal loop insertions are supported by any ledger line.

literature_other_positions.note: NLGN4-HA suffix notation places the HA tag at the C-terminus (residue 816), which lies in the intracellular tail (698–816); not accessible on the extracellular face.
